name: OLMo 2 13B Instruct
definition: OLMo 2 13B Instruct is a dense open-research instruction model developed by Ai2 in the OLMo 2 family. It has 13B parameters, supports 4,096 tokens of context, accepts Text and produces Text. Its primary role is reproducible open research, instruction following and transparent model development.

key_topics: reproducible open research, instruction following and transparent model development

details: OLMo2 architecture with openly documented training stack

training.summary: A defining feature of OLMo 2 is not only weight access but the broader research release: Ai2 publishes model weights together with training data information, checkpoints, code, logs and the Open Instruct/Tülu post-training recipes. The instruct variants use supervised fine-tuning, preference optimization and reinforcement-learning-from-verifiable-rewards style stages.

license.special_conditions: Includes an express patent grant. Model-specific acceptable-use policies, if separately published, are not automatically part of Apache 2.0.
license.legal_note: OpenWeightModels summary for technical comparison; not legal advice.

deployments.notes: Official model card documents an OpenAI-compatible SGLang server.
Ai2 provides a direct Docker Model Runner example for the 32B and related checkpoints.

hardware.summary: 13B dense parameters make this a conventional weight-memory sizing problem rather than sparse MoE routing. The 4K context keeps KV-cache growth comparatively modest, but BF16 weight memory still determines whether a single accelerator or multi-GPU setup is required.

limitations: The configured 4K context is short by current long-context standards.
Research openness does not mean every downstream dataset or deployment has no separate obligations.
Smaller context may require retrieval/chunking for large-document use.

change_history.change: Gold-standard Passport v2.0 created with full technical, license, deployment and SEO/GEO review.
